item.title: Memento Shoujo no Karada ni Kizamareta, Saimin to Kairaku no Kioku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura Konmai Studio
  • 発売日: 2013-04-26
  • スコア: 6.1899999999999995/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: memento 少女のカラダに刻まれた、催眠と快楽の記憶
  • 英語名: Memento Shoujo no Karada ni Kizamareta, Saimin to Kairaku no Kioku

あらすじ

Leonid is a private detective in a small town in Northern Europe.

One day while he is alone in office a masked person accompanied by a girl in a wheel chair appear in front of him. The masked person draws a gun and demands that Leonid puts the girl in the wheel chair, Ekaterina, under hypnosis to solve a mystery in her past.

  • 日本語名: しすたーめいでんっ！ ～坂上姉妹の24時間耐久エッチ合宿～
  • 英語名: Sister Maiden! Sakagami Shimai no 24 Jikan Taikyuu Ecchi Gasshuku

あらすじ

Sakagami Sakura and Momiji are high school girls at a certain school.

One day, the two overhear the boys whispering about them—calling them the “Iron Maidens.” Frustrated and unsure how to respond, they turn to their longtime classmate Eiji for advice.

“Ugh, a playboy like you wouldn’t get our problems anyway.”
